name: Wall Walker Josie

intro.text: I'm doing the Hadrian's Wall Path, 84 miles, coast to coast. I have done nine of them. I'm told the milecastles are good for a sit-down. They are. It's the standing-up that's hard.

win: You're a hard woman to hold at a milecastle. Well done.
after: I might finish the path by Christmas. Which one, I'm not saying.
